answer: Graph-depth attestation at the inlet: each identity's weight equals its shortest path to a seeded root, so a farm must forge an unbroken thread of vouches back to genesis. The check is that weight decays per hop, so faking depth k costs k real attestations. One gale of Sybil signups adds leaves, not depth, and weight stays near zero. Cost scales linearly while influence stalls — that is why it works.
